The '''SA20''', also known as the '''[[Betway]] SA20''' for sponsorship reasons, is a [[Twenty20]] franchise [[cricket]] tournament in [[South Africa]], organised by [[Cricket South Africa]] (CSA) and first contested during the [[2023 SA20 season|2023 season]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/cricket-south-africa-announces-new-six-team-franchise-based-t20-competition-1312731 |title=Cricket South Africa announces new six-team franchise-based T20 competition |work=ESPN Cricinfo}}</ref><ref name="csa">{{cite web |url=https://cricket.co.za/2022/04/29/t20-comes-home-as-csa-and-supersport-announce-grand-new-event/ |title=T20 COMES HOME AS CSA AND SUPERSPORT ANNOUNCE GRAND NEW EVENT |work=Cricket South Africa |access-date=14 August 2022 |archive-date=1 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231201134828/https://cricket.co.za/2022/04/29/t20-comes-home-as-csa-and-supersport-announce-grand-new-event/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is contested by six teams based in cities around the country.<ref name="players">{{cite web |date=12 August 2022 |title=CSA T20 League 2023: List of players signed up for the first edition |url=https://www.wisden.com/cricket-news/csa-t20-league-2023-list-of-players-signed-up-for-the-first-edition |work=Wisden}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/csa-t20-league-to-be-called-sa20-player-auction-to-be-held-on-september-19-1331697 |title=CSA T20 league to be called 'SA20'; player auction to be held on September 19 |work=ESPN Cricinfo |access-date=31 August 2022}}</ref> [[Sunrisers Eastern Cape]] have won three of the first four editions of the tournament, with [[MI Cape Town]] winning the third season. The primary sponsor is [[Betway]], sponsoring the league since it launched.

==History==
Cricket [[South Africa]] established the franchise [[T20 Global League]] in 2017. The inaugural season was deferred by a year due to the lack of a broadcast deal and title sponsor and in June 2018 was replaced by the [[Mzansi Super League]], a league featuring six [[Cricket South Africa|CSA]]-owned teams.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-07-24 |title=Haroon Lorgat calls for independent inquiry into 'collapsed' T20 Global League |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/haroon-lorgat-calls-for-independent-inquiry-into-collapsed-t20-global-league/story-t88irsR7NaudoyWAJXMgKN.html |access-date=2022-08-11 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en}}</ref> It did not become a huge success.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The SA20 player auction: all you need to know |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/sa20-player-auction-all-you-need-to-know-1335262 |access-date=2022-10-12 |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref> The MSL ran for only two seasons, the 2020 and 2021 editions being cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].

SA20 was established by CSA in 2022 through a newly formed entity, Africa Cricket Development (Pty) Limited (ACD). CSA is the majority stakeholder in ACD with a 50% share, while broadcaster [[SuperSport (South African broadcaster)|SuperSport]] has a 30% share and former [[Indian Premier League]] (IPL) Chief Operating Officer [[Sundar Raman]], the remaining 20%.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=CSA confident of seeing off legal challenge to new T20 league |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/cricket-south-africa-confident-of-seeing-off-legal-challenge-to-new-t20-league-1325772 |access-date=2022-08-11 |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref> All six of the teams were bought by franchises from the IPL.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/south-africa-new-t20-league-csk-mi-delhi-capitals-rajasthan-royals-kevin-pietersen-interested-in-buying-franchises-1313604 |title=CSK, Mumbai Indians interested in buying franchises in South Africa's new T20 league |work=ESPN Cricinfo |date=13 August 2022}}</ref> In July 2022, CSA announced that the [[One Day International]] series against [[Australia national cricket team|Australia]] due to be played in January 2023 would be cancelled in order for SA20 to go ahead.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-07-13/south-africa-withdraws-from-australia-odi-series/101234794 |title=South Africa's men's cricket team withdraws from three-match ODI series against Australia in January |work=ABC News |date=13 July 2022 |access-date=13 August 2022}}</ref>

In August 2022, [[Graeme Smith]] was announced as the commissioner for the tournament.<ref name=":0">{{cite news |title=Graeme Smith Named as Commissioner for CSA's New T20 league |url=https://www.timesofsports.com/cricket/news/graeme-smith-named-as-commissioner-for-csas-new-t20-league/amp/ |access-date=13 August 2022 |work=Times of Sports |archive-date=17 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117064842/https://www.timesofsports.com/cricket/news/graeme-smith-named-as-commissioner-for-csas-new-t20-league/amp/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Later in the month, the marquee players for the first season were announced.<ref name="players" />

In December 2023 Cricket South Africa announced that it would send a makeshift Test team, comprising players with little or no Test cricket experience, to its scheduled two-Test tour of [[New Zealand national cricket team|New Zealand]] in February 2024, to allow its best players to remain in South Africa to compete in the SA20. The decision was widely criticised.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/a-south-africa-test-squad-with-just-seven-capped-players-1414855 |title=A South Africa Test squad with just seven capped players |work=ESPN cricinfo |date=30 December 2023 |access-date=31 December 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/aug/30/thes-spin-south-african-cricket-faustian-pact-has-kept-lights-on-but-at-price |title=South African cricket's Faustian pact keeps the lights on, but at a price |work=The Guardian |date=30 August 2023 |access-date=31 December 2023}}</ref> In January 2025, Cricket South Africa announced the windows for the competition for 2026, 2027, and 2028.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/sports/cricket/sa20-window-for-next-three-seasons-revealed-next-edition-likely-to-begin-on-boxing-day-2025-02-04-974558 |title=SA20: Window for next three seasons revealed, next edition likely to begin on Boxing day |work=IndiaTV|access-date=4 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.in/cricket/story/_/id/43677199/next-season-sa20-likely-begin-boxing-day |title=Next season's SA20 likely to begin on Boxing Day |work=ESPN|access-date=4 February 2025}}</ref>

==Organisation==
The six teams play each other twice in the group stages of the competition before the top four teams move to the [[Playoff format|playoffs stage]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=SA20 2022/23 Table, Matches, win, loss, points for SA20 |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/series/sa20-2022-23-1335268/points-table-standings |access-date=2023-02-05 |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref>

Teams acquire players through an auction as opposed to a draft, making it the third  cricket league in the world after the [[Indian Premier League]] and [[International League T20]] to do so. Each team purchases a squad of 17 players, with the opportunity of signing up to five players prior to the auction: three international players; one South African international player; and one uncapped South African player.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Cricket South Africa {{!}} GLOBAL CRICKET SUPERSTAR LINED UP FOR SOUTH AFRICA T20 LEAGUE |url=https://cricket.co.za/2022/08/10/global-cricket-superstar-lined-up-for-south-africa-t20-league/ |access-date=2022-08-11 |language=en-US |archive-date=10 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810185805/https://cricket.co.za/2022/08/10/global-cricket-superstar-lined-up-for-south-africa-t20-league/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CSA T20 league: Livingstone and Buttler in top salary bracket as England, SA players hit paydirt |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/csa-t20-league-eleven-from-england-including-eoin-morgan-and-jason-roy-among-30-plus-marquee-players-to-sign-up-1328571 |access-date=2022-08-11 |website=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref>

===Prize money===
[[Cricket South Africa]] increased the prize money for the SA20 in 2024 to a total of $890,000 . The prize money is split between the teams as follows:<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sagar |first=Singh |date=2024-02-11 |title=SA20 2024 Winner Prize Money, Complete List of Award-Winners, Top Records & Stats  All You Need To Know|url=https://www.crictracker.com/cricket-news/sa20-2024-winner-prize-money-awards/ |access-date=2024-02-10 |website=CricTracker |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | title=SA20 Prize Money And Full List Of Awards: How Much Amount Did Sunrisers Eastern Cape Get After 3rd Title {{!}} Cricket News | url=https://sports.ndtv.com/cricket/sa20-prize-money-and-full-list-of-awards-how-much-amount-did-sunrisers-eastern-cape-get-after-3rd-title-10886119 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260126105536/https://sports.ndtv.com/cricket/sa20-prize-money-and-full-list-of-awards-how-much-amount-did-sunrisers-eastern-cape-get-after-3rd-title-10886119 | access-date=2026-09-29 | archive-date=2026-01-26}}</ref>

*R16,250,000– To the [[#Tournament_results|runner up]] 
*R32,500,000 – To the [[#Tournament_results|champion]] of the season

The total prize money in the SA20 is R70 million.

=== Trophy ===
The trophy for the Betway T20 was unveiled in January 2023. The 24-carat gold and silver-plated trophy was designed and made by British silverware manufacturers [[Thomas Lyte]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=on |first=Published |date=2023-01-07 |title=SA20 trophy a 'masterpiece' |url=https://www.sacricketmag.com/sa20-trophy-a-masterpiece/ |access-date=2025-08-28 |website=SA Cricketmag |language=en-US}}</ref> It features six handles, representing league's six founding franchises, with the tournament's logo engraved on the front of the trophy.<ref>{{Cite web |title=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/inaugural-betway-sa20-trophy-on-show |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/inaugural-betway-sa20-trophy-on-show |access-date=2025-08-28 |website=www.sa20.co.za |language=en}}</ref>

==Teams==
The six teams are all owned by existing [[Indian Premier League]] franchise owners.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-franchise-owners-buy-all-six-teams-in-south-africas-new-t20-league-1325425 |title=IPL franchise owners buy all six teams in South Africa's new T20 league |work=ESPN Cricinfo}}</ref>
